entries.en: Improved how `prompt` hooks on Stop and SubagentStop written as instructions (such as "Carry on if the build is broken") are judged, so Claude is less likely to stop early
entries.zh: 改进对 Stop 和 SubagentStop 上以指令形式写的 `prompt` hook（如“如果构建失败就继续”）的判断方式，减少 Claude 提前停下来的可能

entries.en: Fixed `prompt` and `agent` hooks written as instructions (such as "Block commands that...") allowing what they should block
entries.zh: 修复了以指令形式编写的“提示”和“代理”挂钩（例如“阻止...的命令”），允许它们应该阻止的内容
